metadata.title: DataCareNext production work packages
metadata.sizing: Relative only: XS < S < M < L < XL. Calendar dates require team capacity and external-evidence availability.

principles: Desktop behavior, data, reports, keyboard flow and device outcomes remain authoritative; only the technology stack changes.
A route, page, model, HTTP 200, build or mock/unit test is engineering progress, never parity evidence.
Parity percentage is computed only from desktop_compared=passed units in the generated matrix.
Critical invariants are release vetoes and cannot be averaged away by lower-risk completion.
No client request is authoritative for scope, rights, numbering, reversal state, totals, stock or tag availability.
All new dependencies are exact/pinned and pass security/license review.
Every vertical slice follows extract, specify, test-first, implement, review, real-test, desktop-compare and evidence-promotion.
Missing evidence blocks the relevant gate; it is not replaced by guessed behavior.

waves.name: Evidence, CI and executable test foundations
waves.purpose: Make future claims reproducible and fail closed.

waves.name: Schema, isolation, authorization and session spine
waves.purpose: Establish authoritative identity and data boundaries before business mutations.

waves.name: Transaction integrity engines
waves.purpose: Correct numbering, posting, stock, reversal, fine, tax and outstanding invariants.

waves.name: Module vertical slices and desktop UX
waves.purpose: Complete each desktop workflow on the corrected engines and advance it to G5.

waves.name: Reports and print certification
waves.purpose: Replace generic/fake output with report-specific data and Crystal-equivalent evidence.

waves.name: Devices and external services
waves.purpose: Certify shop hardware and provider integrations under failure.

waves.name: Migration, operations and release certification
waves.purpose: Prove observability, security, performance, restore, cutover, rollback and business acceptance.

workPackages.title: Freeze evidence, gate semantics and one source of truth
scope: Make the generated parity matrix authoritative
Require evidence URI, verifier, timestamp and result metric
Invalidate downstream evidence when source changes
deliverables: Decision log for intentional architecture substitutions
acceptance: Matrix universes remain 204 forms, 146 tables, 255 supplied plus 20 absent report obligations and 57 settings unless an approved baseline change explains drift
No G3-G6 pass can exist without qualifying artifacts
All active documentation identifies Fastify and the authoritative deployment path

workPackages.title: Make CI real and green
scope: Fix 704 formatting failures without semantic changes
Run uncached tests where evidence matters
Replace existing open dependency ranges with reviewed exact versions
acceptance: CI fails on formatting, lint, type, test, build, schema or generated-matrix drift
Lint reports files/rules executed rather than zero tasks
All production workspace dependencies are exact/pinned; no open range is introduced or retained without an expiring exception

workPackages.title: Consolidate one production deployment path
scope: Remove or quarantine stale apps/api Docker and Redis stack
Enforce production secret and role guards
acceptance: One documented command builds and starts the tested stack
Readiness fails when DB, RLS role or mandatory renderer is unavailable
Production refuses default JWT/DB credentials
No health check targets an unregistered route

workPackages.title: Disposable real-PostgreSQL integration harness
scope: Start isolated PostgreSQL per CI job
Apply migrations, roles, RLS and seed fixtures
Capture before/after rows and transaction failures
acceptance: CI proves migration from empty database and from previous release
Tests call createSale/createPurchase/postVoucherTx/reverseVoucherTx/nextVoucherNoTx/issueTagTx/withTenant through real transactions
No test can silently use an unidentified developer database

workPackages.title: Deterministic desktop comparison harness
scope: Normalize nondeterministic dates/IDs only by approved rules
acceptance: One command runs the same scenario against desktop and web
Persisted decimal values compare at schema scale and business keys
Ledger/stock/tag/tax/outstanding aggregates compare exactly
Every G5 pass cites retained comparison artifacts

workPackages.title: Recover externally blocked report evidence
deliverables: Complete or explicitly blocked report specs
acceptance: No supplied alternative is ignored
Recovered artifacts pass parser tests
Absent evidence remains a blocking matrix row rather than a guessed layout

workPackages.title: Eliminate Prisma, migration, audit and policy drift
scope: Represent COUNTRY_MAST, IMAGE_DATA, LBR_ISU_IDTL and OP_DETL
acceptance: Desktop schema comparison has no unexplained missing table/column
audit_log exists after normal migration
Prisma validation and migration replay pass
No manual SQL is required but undocumented

workPackages.title: Migration-owned fail-closed tenant isolation
scope: ENABLE and FORCE RLS on every tenant table
acceptance: Application role is NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS and not table owner
Zero cross-tenant reads/writes under adversarial tests
Startup/readiness fails if any required FORCE policy is absent

workPackages.title: Authoritative company/location/year/book context
scope: Derive business scope from signed server context
Apply scope predicates to generic and bespoke services
acceptance: context/select cannot mint unauthorized scope
lcCode never falls back to company code
Every mutation and read proves tenant plus active business scope
Adversarial overrides receive denial and leave zero row changes

workPackages.title: Server-side USER_SET form/action authorization
scope: Map every route to desktop form/capability
acceptance: Direct endpoint calls cannot bypass hidden navigation
No USER_SET row denies by explicit approved policy
All 252 routes are mapped or explicitly public/system
View/Edit/Delete/Print matrices pass for multiple users

workPackages.title: Complete password migration and session security
scope: Force reset or atomically rehash plaintext login
acceptance: No plaintext password remains after successful migration
forcedReset cannot reach the ERP before reset
Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite cookie policy passes behind the real proxy
Logout/revocation invalidates sessions according to policy

workPackages.title: Durable, isolated and observable audit trail
acceptance: Every privileged or financial mutation emits one correlated audit event
Audit failure rolls back required mutations or triggers an explicit fail-closed policy
Cross-tenant audit access is impossible

workPackages.title: Typed configuration and book/workflow policy registry
scope: Separate editable storage from applied behavior
acceptance: Unknown/invalid values fail with actionable errors
Each key has an owner and consumer or documented deprecation
Book/company overrides are deterministic
Settings changes are authorized and audited

workPackages.title: Authoritative desktop-style shell, context and navigation
acceptance: Context switch is server-authorized and reloads all scoped state
Menu rights match server rights
No destination displays ready unless its gate state allows the label
Desktop shell screenshots/focus traces are compared

workPackages.title: Browser E2E, visual, accessibility and keyboard harness
acceptance: CI runs browser tests against the real API/database stack
Tests cover permission denials and rollback/error UI
Visual changes require reviewed baseline evidence
No passWithNoTests configuration can hide an empty suite

workPackages.title: Desktop keyboard, focus and grid interaction engine
acceptance: Every mapped key has a state-specific action or intentional no-op
Focus sequences match desktop traces
Grid edits cannot silently lose or double-commit rows
Supported browser/OS keyboard UAT passes

workPackages.title: Per-scope transactional voucher numbering
acceptance: Concurrent allocations across same and different books/years never duplicate or cross scopes
1000-way stress test passes repeatedly
Imported numbering state and year rollover match desktop-approved behavior

workPackages.title: Workflow-specific metal fine and rounding policies
acceptance: No universal helper can be called without a workflow policy
UI preview, API validation and persisted values are identical at storage scale
All source-observed branches have vectors; unresolved branches remain blocked rather than guessed

workPackages.title: Atomic money/metal posting and lock enforcement
acceptance: Every posting/reversal has exact zero money and per-metal balance at storage scale
Injected failure at each write rolls back every voucher/satellite/audit row
Locked dates reject create/edit/delete/reversal
Retries cannot double-post

workPackages.title: Complete signed stock and atomic tag lifecycle
scope: MAIN_STOCK for every loose and tagged line
Desktop BAR_DETL and web TAG_STOCK interoperability
acceptance: Sale/purchase/returns create correct signed movement for lines without tagNo
Two concurrent consumers cannot both sell one tag
On-hand equals signed movement and exact tag state after every workflow
Desktop-imported and web-created tags follow one certified lifecycle

workPackages.title: Server-derived complete edit/delete/reversal
acceptance: DELETE with only voucher identity restores/removes every derived artifact
Client-supplied reversal totals/tags are ignored or rejected
A second reversal is idempotently rejected
Locked period and unauthorized user leave zero changes

workPackages.title: GST, bill outstanding, tender and allocation lifecycle
acceptance: GST header/detail/register totals reconcile exactly
Receipt/payment/reversal produce the desktop bill balance
Interstate/intrastate/rounding/return vectors pass
No tender can exceed or duplicate settlement outside desktop rules

workPackages.title: Real-DB invariant, isolation and concurrency certification
acceptance: Repeated parallel runs produce zero duplicate voucher identities, double-consumed tags or unbalanced ledgers
All unauthorized/cross-scope attempts leave zero changes
Failure injection leaves no partial satellite state
Tests run in normal CI, not optional live scripts

workPackages.title: Complete all 33 desktop master workflows

acceptance: Every master row in the matrix reaches G5
Auto-code, validation, lookup, focus, delete restriction and dependent updates match desktop
No generic renderer is credited without a per-form acceptance artifact

workPackages.title: Finance, cash/bank, ledger and opening workflows
acceptance: All finance form rows in scope reach G5
Money/metal/bill/tender/audit state reconciles on create/edit/delete
Period, rights, numbering and concurrency tests pass

Fine/tax/outstanding/loyalty/old-metal/tender branches match desktop

workPackages.title: Purchase, purchase return, hallmark, other and fine workflows

Deleting a purchase cannot leave an orphan usable tag
All purchase matrix rows reach G5

workPackages.title: Inventory, tags, lots, transfers and physical stock

Signed stock, tag identity, lot and physical variance reconcile exactly

workPackages.title: Karigar, manufacturing, job-work, repair and melting

workPackages.title: Dhiran/pledge issue, receipt, interest and reports

acceptance: Monthly/day/term/compound cases match approved desktop vectors
Partial/full receipt and reversal preserve packet/outstanding state

workPackages.title: Membership, loyalty and saving schemes

Membership forms/reports reach G5

workPackages.title: Utilities and support-class equivalence
acceptance: Every utility/support matrix row has an approved G2 mapping
User-visible utilities in contracted scope reach G5
Infrastructure helpers have proved equivalent behavior rather than forced one-to-one screens

workPackages.title: Close every no-current-evidence form
acceptance: Matrix contains zero no-current-evidence rows in contracted scope

workPackages.title: Report-specific parameters, datasets and formula contracts

workPackages.title: Pinned production browser and renderer readiness

workPackages.title: Crystal-equivalent report and print engine
deliverables: Feature-complete renderer or explicit per-report bespoke templates
acceptance: No silent formula blank/default dataset
Page count/text/barcode/data are exact
Normalized object geometry is within approved one-pixel tolerance
Print rights and audit apply server-side

workPackages.title: Certify all supplied and referenced reports in risk tiers
acceptance: Every report obligation in contracted scope reaches G5
Text/data/barcodes/page setup are exact and anti-alias-only pixel variance stays within approved threshold
SalesQuotation/TagStkIdtlRpt/20 absent reports remain release blockers until evidence is recovered or scope is formally changed

workPackages.title: Secure local scale/camera/scanner/printer bridge
deliverables: Signed least-privilege local agent or approved browser APIs
acceptance: No arbitrary local command/file access
Weight/photo/scan/print round trips match supported hardware
Disconnect/retry cannot duplicate a transaction or label
Each supported device/OS/browser combination has retained certification evidence

workPackages.title: Certify e-invoice, messaging and rate providers
acceptance: Retries do not duplicate IRNs/messages/mutations
Provider responses reconcile to voucher state
Credentials never enter source/logs
Fallback behavior is explicit, authorized and monitored

workPackages.title: Repeatable desktop-to-web data migration and reconciliation
scope: Full history or approved opening migration
acceptance: Repeated dry runs are deterministic
No source data is mutated
Counts/business keys/ledger balances/stock/tag/outstanding/tax reconcile
Every rejected row has an owned remediation decision

workPackages.title: Structured observability, readiness and business-invariant alerts
acceptance: A failed/slow voucher is traceable end to end without logging secrets
Readiness reflects DB/RLS/renderer/external critical dependencies

Alerts are exercised in a game day

workPackages.title: Offsite backup, restore and disaster recovery certification
acceptance: A clean environment restores without undocumented steps
Restored ledger/stock/tag/audit checksums match
Measured RPO/RTO meet signed objectives
Backup age/failure is alerted

workPackages.title: Independent application, database, container and secrets security gate
acceptance: Zero open critical/high exploitable findings
Cross-tenant/company and per-form authorization tests pass
No production defaults/secrets
Any accepted lower risk has owner, reason and expiry

workPackages.title: Representative load, concurrency and capacity certification
acceptance: Signed p95/p99 latency/error targets pass at expected peak plus safety margin
No invariant failure/deadlock exhaustion/data drift under load
Resource limits and scale thresholds are documented and alerted

workPackages.title: Dry-run, cutover, dual reconciliation and failback
acceptance: At least two representative dry runs meet the window
Final money/metal/stock/tag/outstanding/tax/numbering checks are exact
Rollback is rehearsed and preserves a clear system of record
Any veto condition stops cutover automatically

workPackages.title: Role/site/device/statutory business acceptance
acceptance: All contracted matrix units are G5 passed
All 25 critical invariants are G5 passed
No unresolved critical/high defect
Authorized business owners sign by role/site/statutory scope

workPackages.title: Final independent production certification
acceptance: Every contracted unit is production_certified=passed or explicitly out of product scope before baseline freeze
All release vetoes are false
Restore/security/load/device/provider/UAT evidence is current
Independent reviewer can reproduce the decision from retained artifacts

entry: Generated audit and parity matrix exist
Environment is isolated from real business data
requiredControls: Fake/content-free PDF cannot appear as a successful business document
exit: Every C/H blocker has an owner, failing test and work package
stop: Any real customer data or transaction is introduced
A synthetic/fake document can be mistaken for a valid output

entry: QA-DB-INTEGRATION, FOUNDATION-RLS, FOUNDATION-SCOPE, FOUNDATION-RBAC, AUTH-SESSION-HARDENING and OPS-OBSERVABILITY complete
Web mutation is technically disabled for pilot users
Migration dry run and comparison harness are available
allowed: Read-only lookup/report comparison using sanitized or controlled mirror data
exit: Zero unexplained row/aggregate divergence on the shadow corpus
No cross-tenant/company leak or wrong-dataset report
stop: Any web write reaches the mirrored source-of-record scope
Any report silently binds the wrong dataset

releaseStages.systemOfRecord: web for explicitly bounded company/location/book/users; desktop retained as hot fallback
entry: All W1 and W2 packages complete
C1-C5 and H1-H6/H9 blockers closed with real-DB evidence
At least Tier 0 reports are G5
allowed: Bounded live transactions approved by named business owner
exit: At least one complete statutory/business cycle has zero unexplained divergence
Pilot forms/reports/devices/providers reach G5/G6 as applicable

entry: All contracted matrix units are G5
No unresolved critical/high defect or evidence gap in contracted scope
allowed: General production use within certified deployment/site/device/provider scope
exit: 30-day heightened monitoring and reconciliation close without material incident
stop: Evidence becomes stale or a critical invariant regresses

globalReleaseVetoes: Per-form RBAC or authoritative company/location/year/book scope is not enforced server-side
A content-free/fake PDF can return success outside an explicitly watermarked synthetic demo
No passing desktop PDF/image comparison exists for required statutory and transactional reports
No successful measured restore drill meets approved RPO/RTO
CI does not apply migrations/RLS and execute real integration, isolation and concurrency suites
Any critical invariant is regressed, blocked or not tested at the release-required gate

autonomousParityLoop.unitOfWork: One matrix unit or one tightly coupled invariant plus its dependent UI/API/DB/report surfaces.

stages.name: select-and-freeze
stages.output: Matrix row, severity, dependencies, desktop baseline hashes and acceptance checks.

stages.name: extract-or-recover
stages.output: Fresh source/schema/layout/video/runtime evidence; promote G1 only with artifact.

stages.name: specify
stages.output: Approved behavior contract: fields, focus, keys, validation, calculations, SQL/table ownership, posting/reversal, errors, reports/devices; promote G2 only when unresolved critical semantics are zero.

stages.name: write-failing-tests
stages.output: Desktop vectors plus unit, real-DB integration, authorization, failure, concurrency and browser tests that fail for the missing behavior.

stages.name: implement
stages.output: Smallest complete vertical change using authoritative scope/rights/policies and exact pinned dependencies; promote G3 only when the full contract is reachable.

stages.name: independent-review
stages.output: Fresh reviewer checks source links, scope/RBAC/RLS, atomicity, concurrency, reversal, formulas, reports and unsupported completion claims.

stages.name: validate
stages.output: Uncached relevant unit plus migrated real-DB/browser/security/concurrency/failure tests; promote G4 only when CI retains results.

stages.name: desktop-compare
stages.output: Row/aggregate, calculation, keyboard/focus, screenshot and PDF diff artifacts; promote G5 only on exact/approved thresholds.

stages.name: certify-and-promote
stages.output: Load/security/observability/restore/device/site/UAT evidence; promote G6, regenerate matrix and select next dependency-ready unit.

failureRouting: Extraction gap returns to stage 2 or marks the unit blocked/evidence_gap.
Behavior ambiguity returns to stage 3 and requests only the external decision the repository cannot supply.
Review or test failure returns to the earliest stage whose assumption was wrong.
Desktop comparison failure returns to specification if semantics differ, otherwise implementation/test.
Source changes invalidate stale downstream evidence and set affected gates to regressed.
agentRules: Continue autonomously through all repository-answerable questions.
Never guess missing formulas, report datasets, device behavior or business policy.
Never mutate production/customer data or use an unidentified database.
Never transmit source, secrets or customer data to third parties.
Use an independent reviewer before gate promotion.
Update matrix evidence in the same change as implementation and tests.
Do not begin a unit whose hard dependency has failed; work on another dependency-ready unit instead.

workPackage: Matrix is regenerated without assertions or drift
program: All G6 operational evidence is current
Independent audit and business sign-off approve GA

externalInputs.input: Compatible Windows desktop and Crystal runtime
Sanitized representative customer databases and retention decision
Business decisions for Dhiran, VP/GOLD_BOOK, rounding/book and unresolved formula variants
Supported printer/scale/scanner/camera models and shop OS/browser matrix
Provider sandboxes/credentials and legal retention requirements
Expected concurrency/data volume/latency and approved RPO/RTO
